purpose: ONS mid-2025 UK resident population by single year of age (0 to 89 and 90 and over) and sex (MYE2, the edition of 1 October 2026), usual residents including communal establishments. Report-only (microcosm#1095, uk-data#600's age check): uk_runtime.single_year_ages reports a built file's persons by single year of age against it; no stage draws from it and no target binds it. The SPI stage's mid-2023 ages stay in ons_single_year_age_populations.json.
policy: Rows are copied verbatim from the pinned Chronicle consumer feed named in source_fact_feed; every value is a publisher-stated fact. Consumers declare their own arithmetic on these rows and never edit this file by hand: regenerate it with tools/vendor_uk_ledger_facts.py.
